about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Front-End Engineer with over 6 years of experience building scalable and high-performance web applications. Born in Venezuela and currently based in Santiago, Chile, I specialize in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with a strong focus on UI architecture, performance optimization, and code maintainability.

I've had the opportunity to contribute to challenging projects in both corporate and startup environments, including the development of the complete in-store pickup cycle for Cencosud and international projects like SoundExchange, Whitepages, and Campomar. My experience ranges from creating internal UI libraries published to AWS CodeArtifact, to implementing CI/CD pipelines and migrating legacy architectures to modern solutions with React and Redux, achieving significant performance improvements.

Beyond code, I'm passionate about continuous learning and staying current with the latest trends in Front-End development. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams under agile methodologies and contributing to products that create real impact for users.
